title: Apple beats on Q2 earnings, thanks to China & iPhone sales
title_zh: 苹果第二季度盈利好于中国和 iPhone 销售
summary: Apple (AAPL) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.01 (compared to analyst estimates of $1.96), and revenue came in at $111.2 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $109.66 billion).
summary_zh: 苹果公司（AAPL）周四收盘后公布了第二季度业绩。调整后每股收益 (EPS) 为 2.01 美元（分析师预期为 1.96 美元），收入为 1,112 亿美元（分析师预期为 1,096.6 亿美元）。
